note: The two integer patterns are decomposed into alternation arrays built by `anchoredAlternation`, the radix branches in the parser become a prefix table, and the resolver picks its pattern up front. The binary alternative is written `[^-+]?` instead of `[-+]?` among three sibling fragments that are not. Same defect as js-yaml-15.
